profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - IT Manager/Director
profile.summary: Highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with a proven track record of success in developing and modernizing software solutions across various industries. At Medidata Solutions, I collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to best practices, introducing new approaches to software development and fostering team collaboration. I mentor Junior and Intermediate Engineers in Clojure best practices, enhancing productivity and code quality. Proficient in developing Restful APIs and libraries in Clojure, consuming GraphQL services, and utilizing AWS Lambda in Python. Experienced in improving observability and performance and automating CD/CI pipelines using Infrastructure as Code. Additionally, I have a strong background in IoT microservices development and liaison with external partners such as Google. My expertise extends to bug fixing, refactoring, code reviews, and ensuring unit test coverage. Prior roles include Senior IT and Processes Manager/Director at ASSA Insurance, where I spearheaded automation initiatives, led successful software projects, and achieved significant revenue growth.

positions.description:

- Refactoring a Clojure Backend to migrate from Korma to next.jdbc, from Compojure to Reitit/Muuntaja including middleware and exception handling.

- Unit Tests, Pair Programming, Clojure Training for Beginners
- Deploying with Medistrano, Travis, Artifactory, GHA

positions.title: Senior Manager - Information Technology and Processes
positions.description:
- 2019-2020 – Project Manager for IBM Business Process Management to automate, monitor and optimize processes with IBM business process management solution. This project requires stakeholder’s identification and analysis to engage stakeholders from local, region and outsource teams. Requires managing providers and staff to ensure quality, budget, risks control and a clear identification of objectives and KPIs.
- Also, in 2020 I was Project Leader for ‘Optimización del Modelo Operativo’ to simplify and automate process, to optimize operational efficiency, cutting expenses, improve productivity and service quality, provide increased agility, and reduce risks.
- 2018-2019 Building Relocation Tech Leader: I was tech project leader to ensure a network system, along with data center migration during construction of a building to relocate the office. Plan included activities previous to the move and activities in the building. According to the plan I managed providers and staff to ensure quality, budget, risks control. Building was operative and modern as planned. 
- Improved the Software and Hardware Availability by leading, designing and implementing the company's Business Continuity and Resilience Plan with 3 major occurrences (system upgrade/migration project, earthquake and social unrest)
-   Architected and led bank-insurance software with the development of interoperability systems (SOA oriented) between banks and the company, generating +20MM in revenue
- Coordinated and led several hardware and software development projects (SDLC) with multicultural stakeholders (staff, clients, vendors, country offices, and business partners), implementing project management tools and methodologies raising the productivity by more than 80% through automated processes
- Ensured time, quality and budget in tens of projects for Upgrade/migration from legacy systems
- Provided coaching and guidance to junior staff, and technical training to end users, reducing errors by 80%
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · Conformidad normativa · ITIL · Insurance · Team Leadership · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Leadership · Ciclo de vida de desarrollo de software (SDLC) · Dirección · Management · Coaching · Mentoring
